# OA v0.7.23

**Status:** Public development preview

**Release date:** 2026-08-28

**Source:** [`v0.7.23`](https://github.com/realminc/oa/releases/tag/v0.7.23)

## Summary

OA v0.7.23 is the immutable hosted-release repair for the blocked v0.7.22
foundation candidate. It publishes the same foundation hardening, host-memory,
VKL/VMA boundary, allocator-cache, and `oa::Vector` migration with a bounded
ASAN test budget that accounts for the hardened suite's instrumented
child-process death tests.

Product code, public APIs, allocation algorithms, numerical behavior, and
recorded performance results are unchanged from the v0.7.22 source snapshot.

## Fixed

- ASAN CTests receive a 180-second per-test timeout; UBSAN retains 120 seconds.
- The sanitizer job has an explicit 45-minute ceiling, preserving detection of
  genuine hangs while allowing `TestOaStd` to finish its fail-closed contract
  cases under ASAN instrumentation.
- The v0.7.22 release record now distinguishes its immutable source tag from a
  completed hosted publication.

## Compatibility and migration

- Replace `oa::Vec<T>` with `oa::Vector<T>`.
- Replace `<oa/core/std/vec.h>` with `<oa/core/std/vector.h>`.
- No compatibility alias or forwarding header is provided. Rebuild native
  consumers and discard pre-1.0 binary caches.
- Public OA allocator ownership and Vulkan value contracts are unchanged; VMA
  and VKL remain private implementation dependencies.

## Performance

No performance claim changes in this repair. The complete fixed-host results,
process ranges, correctness oracles, rejected experiments, and limitations are
published in the [foundation benchmark](../benchmarks/oaStd.md) and summarized
in the [v0.7.21 source note](v0.7.21.md).

## Verification

| Gate | Result | Evidence scope |
|---|---|---|
| v0.7.22 Release and packages | Pass | complete hosted build, shader-authority check, staged tarballs, distro packages, and artifact upload |
| v0.7.22 UBSAN | Pass | all 18 selected CTests; `TestOaStd` completed all 272 cases |
| v0.7.22 ASAN | Blocked by test budget | 271/272 `TestOaStd` cases completed without a sanitizer finding; CTest stopped the final case at 120.04 seconds |
| v0.7.22 CPU Vulkan | Pass | Lavapipe build and smoke execution with capability evidence |
| v0.7.22 Python wheel | Pass | repaired manylinux wheel, isolated install, host tests, and crypto-host tests |
| v0.7.23 hosted release | Workflow-owned | complete ASAN/UBSAN, CPU-Vulkan, packages, wheel, PyPI, release assets, and checksums |

## Known limitations

- Linux x86-64 remains the qualified runtime host for the new foundation and
  VMA measurements. Other OS, compiler, architecture, driver, and device
  matrices remain open.
- Binary independence, extended allocation-fault injection, long-running fuzz
  campaigns, and hostile-input qualification remain unfinished.
- The retained fixed-host performance gaps and security/performance tradeoffs
  are unchanged from v0.7.21.
- Vulkan Video and GPU paths remain capability-, queue-, driver-, and
  device-dependent; unsupported routes fail closed.

## Upgrade

Rebuild C++ and Python consumers, apply the `oa::Vector` source migration,
regenerate owned sources, and discard stale build, package, execution-plan,
model, checkpoint, and pre-1.0 binary caches.
